notes_for_editor: Location, county and elevation only. Record coordinates (29.66613, -81.41448) agree with TopoZone (29.66608, -81.41452) to within about 10 m, so no correction. The record has no elevation; TopoZone gives 10 m, which a human could add. No history source was readable: the Forest Lookouts page holds only the name and county, anyplaceamerica returned 403, and the FFLA Florida list gave no usable text. Next step for a human: look for a Waymarking listing or a Florida Forest Service history of Gopher Ridge.
